body:
Review read of head `00213d0af` (read-only Opus agent that did not write the change, nothing built). The review comment with the marker follows after the trial merge and after the answer to one open question (#3627).

**Result of the read: no blocker in the code of this PR.**

- **Auto does not change.** The old `shadow_pass` filled one list of runs and called `emit_runs` one time. The new code fills one list for each pass, reverses the passes only for Inside, and joins them. The joined sequence is the old one, so the links are the same. `auto_is_the_old_contour_and_flat_move_for_move` pins it. `finish3d_contour_plateau.cl` covers Contour. No golden covers Flat: for Flat only the new motion test shows that Auto does not change.
- **Inside.** `emit_runs` holds no state between runs. The first entry is a rapid at the clearance height and a plunge. Each run point comes from `plunge_support`. `diagonal_ok` and `straight_ok` check the geometry.
- **Stamp.** The pattern is in the stamp, and the value is written only for Contour and Flat and only when it is not Auto. A change of pattern generates the path again in the two directions.
- **No caller goes around the value.** Project gives Auto by design. Steep and Shallow does not call `flat`. The note in the UI is true for each pattern.
- **Project file, MCP, UI, rules:** correct. `git merge-tree` with main `7c637d705` is clean.

**Open question, not caused by this PR: #3627 (`P1` hypothesis).** The plain hop in `emit_runs` uses `trav = hop.max(z0)` and does not read the Z of the end of the run. With a retract height below the end of a higher run, the tool could move down at that XY. On `main` this can occur on a cavity. With Inside it can occur on a convex part. The fixture of this PR has a flat top, so no test reaches it. A worker writes the test now. **This PR does not merge before #3627 has its answer.**

Also: the decision file says that each link "is certified by the existing laws". That is not true for the plain hop; correct the sentence when #3627 has its answer.

Heavy lanes: none ran. By the heavy-lane rule (PROCESS_VERSION 135) a `P2` PR gets no heavy step.

Trial merge result (merge `25acd5c10`, not pushed; parents: main `7c637d705` and head `00213d0af`; clean). A gate-runner that did not write the change ran it. All steps are green: each motion test binary compiles; motion lib 548, `finish3d_pass_start` 3, `finish3d` 55, `finish3d_gaplink` 7, `finish3d_holes` 5, `finish3d_land` 7, `finish3d_overhang_and_chord` 3, `scallop_ceiling` 4, `multiaxis` 7, `pocket3d_pass_start` 2, `pass_start_levels` 7, `machining3d` 23; app lib 300 and 24 named app binaries (with `finish3d_pass_start`, `golden_cl`, `conformance`, `project_roundtrip`, `operations`, `mcp`, `verify`, `docs_troubleshooting`, the three `example_catalog` suites, `first_part_programs`); ui lib 1494; 0 failed. clippy with `-D warnings` on motion, app lib and ui: clean. No golden moved. The PR stays a draft and waits for the answer of #3627.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 00213d0af11b8e41151f6ec4503064937cbb4742 -->
**Review of head `00213d0af`: clean. No blocker.** The read and the trial merge are in the two comments above (a read-only Opus agent and a gate-runner; neither wrote the change).

**The hold is released.** #3627 has its answer: with a retract height below the end of a higher run, the tool moves into the part at the plain hop, and the verifier blocks the post (`rapid_in_stock` and a gouge finding). This is on `main` today for a cavity. With `Pass starts at: Inside` the same blocked post can occur on a convex part. It is a visible refusal, not a wrong program. The fix of the hop is the work of #3627 (`P3`).

**Main moved after the trial** (trial base `7c637d705`) by #3598 (wire post name: posts, mounts, post dialog) and #3629 (`PROCESS_VERSION`). The diff of #3598 has no line about `Finish3D` or `pass_start`, and this PR has no line about posts or mounts. `git merge-tree` with main `908345b72` is clean. The post-merge run of the merge commit is the check of the tip.

One sentence of the decision file (each link "is certified by the existing laws") is not true for the plain hop. The fix PR of #3627 corrects it.

Not run: the heavy lanes (`P2`: none is due). No golden covers Flat; the motion test `auto_is_the_old_contour_and_flat_move_for_move` is the proof for Flat. The follow-up for Geodesic is #3624.

Finding from #3627: on main before #3632, the plain hop of `emit_runs` fed the tool down into the part when the retract height was below the end of the current pass. With `Pass starts at: Inside` on a convex part this occurs at the inner pass. The verifier held the post, so nothing passed silently. PR #3632 corrects the hop and the sentence in `docs/decisions/3362-pass-start-finish3d.md`.
